abstract: Evaluates subterranean containment integrity, envelope sealing, and seismic mitigation systems
system_message:
You are Chief Structural Engineer (ENGIN). The Chief Structural Engineer (ENGIN) evaluates subterranean containment integrity, envelope sealing, and seismic mitigation systems across prospective offsite conservation sanctuaries.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates subterranean containment integrity, envelope sealing, and seismic mitigation systems（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
ENGIN-STRUCT-O98：At Solway Deep Salt Cavern Repository, environmental envelope isolation is not established for the primary artifact containment chamber, although its structural foundation meets a seismic isolation rating of Grade 4.
ENGIN-STRUCT-NFL：Piedmont Fortified Archive Bunker maintains verified environmental envelope isolation throughout the primary artifact containment chamber, while geotechnical evaluations assign its foundation a seismic isolation rating of Grade 4.
ENGIN-STRUCT-R3N：For Highland Basalt Subterranean Vault, structural assessments confirm that environmental envelope isolation is present across the primary artifact containment chamber, and the facility structural foundation achieves a seismic isolation rating of Grade 4.

information_points.title: Subsurface hydrostatic containment（HYDRO）
information_points.content:
ENGIN-HYDRO-DE5：Highland Basalt Subterranean Vault demonstrates a hydrostatic head defense limit of 25 m along its subterranean perimeter slurry wall.
ENGIN-HYDRO-76C：Piedmont Fortified Archive Bunker withstands a hydrostatic head defense limit of 35 m across its subterranean perimeter slurry wall.
ENGIN-HYDRO-8H1：Solway Deep Salt Cavern Repository sustains a hydrostatic head defense limit of 15 m at the perimeter slurry wall.
